issue.title: test_stop_live_inline_run_settles_stop_requested hits 'tool run store is busy: database is locked' under the full lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Load-sensitive ToolRun store lock contention in tests/tool/test_lifecycle_controls.py; see the flake report.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-18f.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4, epic sase-18f green-check). In a full `just test` lane on clean master (2026-09-24) the node failed with `tool run store is busy: database is locked`; it then passed 3/3 in isolation on the unchanged tree (~3.9s each). Fail rate: 1 full-lane failure, 0/3 serial. The failure is SQLite busy contention on the ToolRun store under full-suite load, not a deterministic defect; the precise lock holder was not identified, so no narrower size is claimed.
